# Plan: Add audio and accessibility controls

## Sources

`SaveData.preferences` (`muted`, `reducedMotion` where null follows the browser, `effects`) and `resetSave` in `src/progress/save.ts`. `src/render/environment.ts` exposes `setMotion`. `src/style.css` has the `.interference`, `.effects`, and `.blink` rules. `src/main.ts` owns the render host and tools.

## Design

- `src/audio/audio.ts`: `createAudio()` builds everything with Web Audio oscillators and noise buffers, with no files. An `AudioContext` is created only on the first `unlock()`, which `main.ts` calls from the join gesture. Before that, every `play` does nothing. Sounds: `startup`, `interference`, `success`, `error`, and a quiet looping `ambient` drone. `setMuted(true)` silences everything through the master gain, including the ambient loop.
- `src/app/settings.ts`, DOM-free: `effectiveMotion(preferences, systemReduced)` returns whether motion is allowed; `applyPreferences(preferences, systemReduced, targets)` calls the audio and environment targets and sets `document.documentElement`-independent values through an injected `setAttribute`, so it is unit-testable.
- Body attributes `data-motion` (`on`/`off`) and `data-effects` (`on`/`off`) drive CSS. `data-motion=off` hides `.interference` and stops `.blink`. `data-effects=off` hides `.interference` and `.effects`.
- A `SETTINGS` tool opens a panel of native controls: checkboxes `SOUND MUTED`, `REDUCE MOTION`, `SCREEN EFFECTS`, and a `RESET PROGRESS` button. Reset uses an in-panel confirm step (`CONFIRM RESET` and `KEEP PROGRESS`), then clears the save and reloads. A `CLOSE` button closes the panel. Everything is keyboard-operable because the controls are native. `hub.ts` also closes any open panel before running a menu tool, so the analyzer can be left without solving it. Choosing a checkbox stores the explicit choice, and `reducedMotion` stays null until then.
- `main.ts`: the join gesture calls `unlock` and plays `startup`, then starts `ambient`. Analyzer success and failure play `success` and `error`; moving the tune control plays short `interference` ticks. The opening does not play sound.

## Files

New: `src/audio/audio.ts`, `src/app/settings.ts`, `tests/unit/settings.test.ts`, `tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts`. Changed: `src/main.ts`, `src/app/hub.ts`, `src/style.css`, `src/signal/analyzer-view.ts` (an optional `onTune` callback).

Scanlines and interference are decoration only and sit over the text. Text colour and size do not change with the effects setting, so legibility holds either way.

## Out of scope

Authored audio assets, dial-up sound, new puzzle content.

# Test plan

Local commands: `npx vitest run tests/unit/settings.test.ts`, `npm run lint`. Browser evidence comes from the PR's `Browser tests` workflow, which runs `tests/e2e/settings.spec.ts`. Developer and tester may complete with browser evidence pending CI.

| Acceptance criterion | Verification | Owner |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sounds play only after interaction; mute silences and persists | `settings.spec.ts`: a page-level wrapper counts `AudioContext` constructions, and it is 0 before the join gesture and 1 after. After muting, the save holds `muted: true` and a reload keeps the box checked. Source inspection of `audio.ts`: all five sounds, master gain. Unit test: `applyPreferences` forwards mute. | CI; tester inspects source |
| `prefers-reduced-motion` and a setting disable sweep, glitch, rotation | `settings.spec.ts` with `reducedMotion: 'reduce'`: `data-motion=off`, `.interference` hidden, two canvas screenshots a second apart are identical. Same result using the setting with the default media. Unit test of `effectiveMotion`, including that an explicit choice overrides the system. | CI; developer unit |
| Effects toggle disables scanlines and glitch; text readable either way | `settings.spec.ts`: `.effects` and `.interference` hidden after toggling; terminal text computed colour and font size are equal in both states | CI |
| Settings by keyboard; reset asks for confirmation | `settings.spec.ts`: all controls operated with Tab, Space, and Enter. The first press of reset does not clear; `KEEP PROGRESS` keeps; `CONFIRM RESET` clears the save and returns to the opening | CI |

## Roles

- **Developer:** runs the local commands above.
- **Tester:** independently inspects source against the criteria, reuses applicable passing results, repeats only for relevant changes, failures, or unresolved coverage.
- **Coordinator:** alone runs the complete required policy.
